description: Retrieve guideline coverage by source ID, exact gene symbol or exact drug name/ID. Default summary pages complete guideline records with exact drugCount/pairCount. view=drugs or pairs requires by=id and pages only that related collection, retaining its guideline descriptor. Ambiguous drug names page candidates for retry with drugId. Follow page.nextOffset; the 24,000-byte soft budget cuts only between complete rows, with oversizedRow for an indivisible exception. Missing coverage is found=false. Consult linked guidelines before clinical use.

by.description: id requires guidelineId; gene requires geneSymbol; drug requires exactly one exact drugName or drugId. Other selectors must be omitted.

drugId.description: Exact drugId returned by pgx_search_pairs; blank means unset.

drugName.description: Exact case-insensitive source drug name for by=drug; blank means unset.

geneSymbol.description: Gene symbol for by=gene; blank means unset.

guidelineId.description: Positive source guideline ID from pgx_get_guideline by=gene or by=drug results; no valid ID range is inferred.

limit.description: Positive safe-integer row limit; values above 100 are clamped to 100 with a notice (default 25).

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use nextOffset to continue (default 0).

view.description: Summary pages guideline descriptors; drugs or pairs requires by=id and pages only that related collection.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_selector`: Selectors are missing, conflicting or mixed across modes. `query_too_broad`: A bounded source scan or workflow work budget is exceeded. `upstream_query_rejected`: CPIC rejects the generated query. `upstream_rate_limited`: CPIC returns HTTP 429. `upstream_unavailable`: CPIC is unavailable or returns a maintenance page. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
